name: Axe of Fury Weapon Store
desc1: This odd store is somewhat different than most weapon shops, in that
desc2: is almost seems part shrine. The dwarven reverence for a good axe is
desc3: exemplified here-- only the most finely crafted axes are available.
desc4: Sitting in display cases, or hung on the walls, these wickedly-
desc5: gleaming implements of destruction almost radiate a sacred glow. But
desc6: that may be due to the odd lighting.
